Siri and Gemini Integration Confirmed

Apple CEO Tim Cook confirmed the strategic partnership with Google and announced that the Gemini model will be integrated into the iPhone ecosystem and Siri. This step is being implemented as part of Apple’s strategy to support Apple Intelligence, its own AI vision, with externally sourced powerful LLM (Large Language Model) capabilities.

Private Cloud Compute (PCC) Architecture

On the technical side of the partnership, the most critical component is Apple’s “Private Cloud Compute” (PCC) architecture. In scenarios where Siri receives support from Gemini while processing complex queries, the data flow is not sent directly to Google servers. Instead, the process is carried out in a dedicated cloud environment defined by Apple that operates encrypted and without logging.

The system’s technical features include:

  • Data Isolation: Google cannot see or store the processed data.
  • Ad Blocking: Use of the data for ad targeting is prevented.
  • Hybrid Processing: In cases where on-device processing power is insufficient, cloud-based resources are used through a secure tunnel.

This architecture was developed to ensure that users can access advanced AI models without Apple compromising its privacy standards.
